name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.MainActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT search Activity opens from the SDK entry point or Android VIEW and SEND intents. It routes shared text, links, text queries, images, and scan results to search, and provides the SDK's history and news sections.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app loses this version of the iQNECT search screen and cannot route shared or scanned searches through it.
